Resolves #20537

Adds a worked Neural Link debugging post and its Portal entry. The Clock case shows why a constructor-only check missed a state transition: deleted component-style keys exposed wrapper dimensions, while explicit null overrides cleared the inline styles. It credits the original direct-worker investigation and labels the new native walkthrough as a reproduction.

Evidence: L3 (scoped native Neural Link actions plus independent browser DOM reads; rendered Portal article and Mermaid diagram) → L3 required. No runtime changes. External publication remains operator-owned under #19575.

Change class: zero-delta (`docs`). `agent-preflight` is not hosted here; the indexed relative-link guard, whitespace/secrets commit hooks, JSON/index checks and Portal rendering ran.
